The central focus is on a blueberry or chocolate chip bagel with visible dark inclusions and a golden-brown crust. In the foreground, a plain glazed bagel is out of focus, while other bagels (some with seeds) are visible in the background. The lighting highlights the glossy texture of the crusts.
